nameOfQualification: Post Graduate Certificate Programme in Cyber Security and Forensics
description: With the increasing complexity of cyber threats and the rise in digital footprints, there is a need for experts who can safeguard, develop and deploy secure systems and networks. This course covers a wide array of topics, from foundational programming in C/C++ to advanced areas like Ethical Hacking,secure web development, cryptography, system programming, and AI-driven security techniques. By equipping learners with hands-on skills in secure coding, cryptographic techniques, and penetration testing, the program aims to develop professionals ready to tackle real-world cybersecurity challenges.
